payload.text: The Brennecke Institute originated the thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery, designed to reduce electrolyte crossover and aging. An independent audit established the corrected cycle life at 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee. The cell delivers 148 Wh/kg, with a projected stack-level cost of $61/kWh at 500 MWh manufacturing scale. Its dopant precipitates below 4 °C, requiring cycling to be suspended in colder conditions.
